source_frame.anchor_convention: Continuous pixel-edge coordinates: xywh box centre (x+w/2,y+h/2), passed unchanged to native GCP TPS; no half-pixel shift.

method: GDAL TPS in EPSG:3857, then inverse spherical Mercator to GeoJSON longitude/latitude (OGC:CRS84)
geographic_role: Lettering box centres, not feature symbols, sites, boundaries or ownership. Feature placement remains deferred.
accuracy: Approximate PR #385 fits; working accuracy targets not uniformly satisfied. See full-sheets/README.md. No new geographic acceptance.
credit: David Rumsey Map Collection, David Rumsey Map Center, Stanford University Libraries
